profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud, Embedded | Java, C++, Python
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a decade of experience building scalable backend systems in the cloud as well as performant applications in the embedded space.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At AWS Glacier I work on building, maintaining and operating microservices to retrieve customer data from cold storage.  Our asychronous systems operate on Petabyte scale workloads to reliably serve data to customers when they need it at the speed they need it.

Notable projects:
- Lead design and implementation and launch of Glacier Deep Archive data retrieval path
- Lead design and implementation and launch of Glacier IntelligentTiering data retrieval path
- Lead implementation and launch of retrieval support for multi terabyte S3 objects
positions.insights: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Planetary,  I work on embedded systems for ground and flight software components our spacecraft products.

Notable achievements and work:
●	Architected embedded Linux applications in C++ and python as well as Linux drivers for various critical sensors, actuators and other spacecraft functions.
●	Implemented logic for redundant and atomic in-flight software upgrades on the spacecraft.
●	Organized custom linux distro using yocto for main flight computer.  Also conducted performance tuning to enable realtime and non-realtime software on the same system.
●	Created ECC based bootloader solution to reliably boot flight computer from corruption vulnerable data stores.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I came onboard as an intern at Planetary with a very small software team which required learning quickly and taking on a larger responsibility within the team.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Implemented new feature and significantly modified existing architecture.
Substantial C++ development and debugging experience in large code base.

projects.title: GeoPost
projects.description: An android app for virtual geocaching by posting and viewing posts at current GPS locations.
